descriptions.w3d_d30e_rle_fread_801d9fb0: Decodes run-length TGA data from a stream (Mark Kilgard's public gliReadTGA rle_fread): copies pending decoded bytes from the state buffer, reads a packet count, then a repeated value or raw bytes directly into the output or into the lazily allocated state buffer, with verbose tracing; returns elements read. fgetc and fread are stream read calls through virtual slot 3, with end of file reported as 0x90000001.
